title: 五生成元以上の最小幅・一欠落幅
statement: For e=q+2>=5 and u=q+1 or q+2, beta_i(G;k)<=F_i(m,du) for every i>=0. For u=q+2, internal and edge missing offsets are both included; the edge formula retains the indicators at i=q and i=q+1.
quantifiers: All k,e,q,d,m and ordered primitive offsets in scopeW, with u in {q+1,q+2}; all i>=0.
assumptions: G is the actual tangent cone; V=du is the actual completion width; R=dim(0:_G(x,v)) in the original orientation
proof_core: At u=q+1 the arithmetic-sequence formula bounds each positive row by i*C(u+1,i+1); d=1 gives source=target and d>=2 gives V>=u+1. At u=q+2, the endpoint quotient has Hilbert function (1,q,2) for an internal missing offset and (1,q,1) for an edge missing offset. Original-coordinate H_x<=1 gives R=0. The actual Koszul matrices have unit minors; internal blocks give rho_i=2*C(q,i-1)-C(s,i-1-r)-C(r,i-1-s), with r+s=q, and T_i=C(s+1,i-r)+C(r+1,i-s) bounded by both C(q+2,i-1),C(q+2,i) using the two inclusion injections. Edge missing offsets give beta_i<=i*C(q+2,i+1)+1_(i=q)+1_(i=q+1), with the indicators paid by target corrections.

title: 密幅の欠落prefix・lex調和計数と容量差

quantifiers: All parameters in scopeW. The resource clause allows q>=3 and 0<=t<=q; the closure clause requires q>=4 and 2<=t<=q; every 1<=i<=q+2, with i>q+2 zero.
assumptions: G is the actual tangent cone; V=du is the actual completion width; R=dim(0:_G(x,v)) in the original orientation
t=u-1-q; the distinct clauses have the separate q,t ranges stated above
proof_core: Nonzero standard words require distinct missing prefix residues, giving n<=t+1 and original H_x<=t; |A|>u/2 gives distance at most 2 and the resource clause. Apply BHP–EK to one lex ideal with the full Hilbert function, obtaining b_i<=i*C(q+1,i+1)+K*C(q-1,i-1). Parent-child weighted counting on the last r variables gives K<=2t(r-1)/3. For t=2, r=3 gives integral K<=2,R=0; t=3 gives K<=4,R<=3. For t>=4 use r=t. With C_i=C(q,i-1),B_i=C(q+1,i-1),A_i=C(q-1,i-1), define D_i=i[C(q+t+1,i+1)-C(q+1,i+1)]-(q+1+2t)C_i-RB_i-KA_i. Vandermonde yields the t=2,3 bounds and D_i>=[(5t^2-17t-6)/6+(t-1)(q-t)]C_i for t>=4; after t=4+z,q=t+v its bracket times 6 is 5z^2+23z+6+6zv+18v>0.

characteristic: Every field, including characteristic 2. Count inequalities are over integers/rationals, not division inside k; no rank comparison across characteristics.

title: 六生成元以上の疎幅と高次行の正規化移行
statement: For e>=6 and u>=2e-2, beta_i(G;k)<=F_i(m,du) for every i>=0. The comparison includes i=e and all first-row subranges e=6,7,8,9 and e>=10.
quantifiers: All parameters in scopeW with e>=6,u>=2e-2; every i>=0.
assumptions: G is the actual tangent cone; V=du is the actual completion width; R=dim(0:_G(x,v)) in the original orientation
proof_core: Set a=e-1,s=floor(e/2),A={0,a1,...,aq}. Kneser with every proper stabilizer yields distance-sum bound B=u+sum_(j>=0)(u-a-sj)_+. For Delta=sk+b, B=u+Delta^2/(2s)+Delta/2+b(s-b)/(2s)<=B_* and B<=u^2/(e-1), the latter by an explicit nonnegative polynomial. Endpoint and Artin estimates give first-row bounds (e+3)B/3-u+e(e-1)/6 and (e+5)B/4-u+(e-1)e(e+1)/24, and U_i=B*C(e,i)-u*C(e-1,i-1)-C(e-1,i+1). Four exact polynomials close e=6..9; a universal positive quadratic closes e>=10. The second row is checked for e=6,e=7,e>=8. For 2<=i<=e, T_i(u)=i*C(u,i+1)/C(e,i)+ui/e+(e-i)(e-i-1)/(e(i+1)); T_i(e)=e-1+i/e and every width increment i*C(u,i)/C(e,i)+i/e increases with i, so T_i>=T_2>=B.

characteristic: Every field, including characteristic 2. Count inequalities are over integers/rationals, not division inside k; no rank comparison across characteristics.

title: 五生成元の幅6・7とantipodalを含む全幅
statement: For e=5,q=3 and all u>=4, beta_i(G;k)<=F_i(m,du) for every i>=0. At u=7, the integral improvement b1<=9 is asserted only when R>0.
quantifiers: All parameters in scopeW with e=5,q=3,u>=4; all i>=0. Subbranches u=4,5; u=6; u=7 with R=0 or R>0; u>=8 with antipodal or non-antipodal A.

proof_core: Use b1<=P+2,b3<=P-1 and Euler to get b2<=2P, hence rows 2..5 <=(5P+4R,4P+6R-1,P+4R,R). For u=6, P<=8,R=0 and integrality gives beta1<=16; u=7 has P<=10,R<=3 and R>0 forces Q_C degree 4 nonzero, so b1<=9 and beta1<=22. Explicit target tables pay rows 2..5. For u>=8, Kneser growth is at least 3 unless u=2h and A={0,t,h,t+h},0<t<h,gcd(t,h)=1. The non-antipodal distance polynomial B3 gives the first-row bound and its three residue differences (u=8 handled by the floor). Antipodal core is k[y,z,w]/(yz,z^2,zw,(y,w)^h); P=C(h+1,2)+1,b1=h+4,W=h^2-h+2 give target gap (h^2+h-12)/2. Both structures share P<=u^2/4,R<=u^2/4-u; the second-row difference factors and the last three rows extend from u=8 using monotonic C(u,k)/u^2.

title: 巡回三点集合の距離和とsocle antichain
statement: For q=2, |n{0,a,b}|>=min(u,2n+1) for n>=0, W<=1+floor(u^2/4), C(sigma+1,2)<=P<=W and sigma<=u-1. Moreover every degree sigma-1 monomial and its divisors are standard in Q_C.
quantifiers: All parameters in scopeN and every n>=0; the core inequalities themselves are independent of m,d.
assumptions: G is the actual four-generator tangent cone; V=du; Q_C is its normalized integer-core endpoint quotient
P=dim Q_C; sigma=dim soc(Q_C); R=dim(0:_G(x,v)) and H_x are in the original orientation
proof_core: Apply iterated Kneser in the quotient by H=Stab(nA). If H is trivial, |nA|>=2n+1; if nontrivial and proper, gcd(a,b,u)=1 forces |A+H|>=2|H|, giving |nA|>=(n+1)|H|>=2n+2. Use the tail sum W=1+sum_(n>=0)(u-|nA|). Sort socle maximal points by first coordinate: alpha_i>=i,beta_i>=sigma-1-i, so the full triangle of degree <=sigma-1 belongs to the downset.
kind: paper proof retained from V02 with a published Kneser input
characteristic: Every field, including characteristic 2. Count inequalities are over integers/rationals, not division inside k; no rank comparison across characteristics.

title: 純軸・混合標準語と元の向きのheight
statement: For all standard words y^s z^t in Q_C, s+t<=u-2; if st>0 then s+t<=floor(u/2). Hence P<=2u-3+C(floor(u/2),2), H_x<=u-3, and u=3,4 implies the original actual R=0.
quantifiers: All parameters in scopeN and all (s,t) in the core standard-word downset D.
assumptions: G is the actual four-generator tangent cone; V=du; Q_C is its normalized integer-core endpoint quotient
P=dim Q_C; sigma=dim soc(Q_C); R=dim(0:_G(x,v)) and H_x are in the original orientation
proof_core: Pure powers stop before u-1 by a gcd-period relation or the unique exponent q with qa congruent to b mod u. A standard mixed word has no zero-sum subsequence, since one would be replaceable by endpoints. If its length exceeds u/2, Savchev–Chen gives unit-scaled values 1,c with multiplicities R0,T0. The same-degree endpoint replacement of Y_alpha^c forces R0<c; total least representatives give R0+cT0<=u-1. Thus 2(R0+T0)<=u, a contradiction. Counting two axes and the mixed triangle gives P and the original-coordinate ceiling formula gives H_x.
kind: paper proof retained from V02 with a published Savchev–Chen input
characteristic: Every field, including characteristic 2. Count inequalities are over integers/rationals, not division inside k; no rank comparison across characteristics.

title: N4三関係による一括計数と無限第一行
statement: For every q=2 core, with h=floor(u/2),k0=u-b+a and E_h(k0)=C(h-k0+2,2) if k0<=h and 0 otherwise, P<=2u-k0-1+C(h,2)-E_h(k0)<=2u-h-2+C(h,2), sigma<=min(h+1,k0). These bounds close beta1(G)<=F1(m,du) for u=5 and every u>=9.
quantifiers: Universal core estimates: all parameters in scopeN, 2<=k0<=u-1. First-row closure: u=5 or u>=9 only; all m,d in scopeN.
assumptions: G is the actual four-generator tangent cone; V=du; Q_C is its normalized integer-core endpoint quotient
P=dim Q_C; sigma=dim soc(Q_C); R=dim(0:_G(x,v)) and H_x are in the original orientation
proof_core: The three endpoint relations y^b=x^(b-a)z^a, z^(u-a)=y^(u-b)v^(b-a), y^(u-b)z^a=x^(u-b)v^a forbid two pure tails and a mixed rectangle. The axes have 2u-k0-1 possible points. Rectangle multiples are s=u-b+i,t=a+j with i+j<=h-k0, counted exactly by E_h(k0). k0+E_h(k0)>=h+1 gives the improved P bound. Mixed socle first exponents are distinct; if sigma>=k0+1, N_DISTANCE's full degree-k0 triangle contradicts the forbidden mixed word. Combine with R<=1+floor(u^2/4)-u: beta1<=C(h,2)+u+1+floor(u^2/4). Its gap to L1(u) is h(h-5)/2 for u=2h and (h^2-3h-2)/2 for u=2h+1; hence all u>=9. At u=5, P<=7,sigma<=3,H_x<=2 gives R=0 and beta1<=11.

title: 幅4の全m四剰余Gröbner証明
statement: For d=1,u=4,(a,b)=(1,3), every m>=6 and every field, in(I_G)=J0+(b*v^theta_n:b=1,y,y^2,z,z^2), where J0=(y^3,yz,xz^2,z^3), (c,n) is the base degree/offset and theta_n=max(ceil((m-n)/4),0). Consequently beta1(G)<=F1(m,4) for all m>=6.
quantifiers: All fields k and all integers m>=6, including m=6 and every residue class m=4Q+rho>6, rho=0,1,2,3.
assumptions: The monomial order first compares internal weights wt(y)=1,wt(z)=2,wt(x)=wt(v)=0, then ordinary degree, then a fixed lex order
proof_core: The four core relations have initial ideal J0 by independence of free columns 1,y,y^2,z and the x-free z^2 column. For a j>=1 longer representation set r_j=(n-jm) mod4, kappa_j=(jm+r_j-n)/4, lambda=(0,1,2,1), Delta_j=lambda(r_j)-c-kappa_j-j. The exact coordinates are K'=K-kappa_j and L'=L-Delta_j, so nonnegativity is iff K>=kappa_j,L>=Delta_j. 4Delta_j<0 removes the L restriction; restricted z^2 competitors need K>=kappa_j+1 and are covered by free anchors. Monotone kappa_j makes j=1 exact. Forbidden words vanish in actual G, whereas nonforbidden words have maximal order equal to their degree and distinct actual weights in that degree; their independence proves equality in(I_G)=J. Stopping division lifts minimal monomial generators to generators of I_G. At m=6 the count is6 versus9; at m>6 the four residues give counts6,8,8,6 versus actual capacities7,10,9,8.

equations: K',L' coordinate bridge; independence to initial-ideal equality
